subject: Re: imGHUM kickoff - staffing, compute, Corpus migration deadline
body:
Lucia,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Yara 50%, Efe 40%, Gustavo 60%; Farah 30% through May for the pipeline integration scaffolding (her calendar is heavily contested for June, so I've front-loaded her portion deliberately).
- Compute: SDF query benchmarks and fitting runs sit fine on 24 titan-a100 best-effort. No reservation ask.
- Data/platform: the internal capture set (raw scans plus registered point clouds, ~9 TB) lives on Corpus v1 paths today. The Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-10, and our window closes June 29 - so Gustavo migrates the capture set to v2 in the first half of May, before the evaluation runs start. That way our published eval manifests are already v2-native and nothing we hand off breaks when the freeze lands eleven days after our close.

One dependency to watch: the head and hand models need a licensing-note review before any external-facing use; flagged to legal, not a blocker for internal eval.

Daniela
